de: Pope John VIII gives blessings to Branimir of Croatia and to the Croatian people, considered to be international recognition of the Croatian state.

te: Pope John VIII recognises the Duchy of Croatia under Duke Branimir as an independent state.
dz: 教宗约翰八世承认布兰尼米尔公爵领导下的克罗地亚公国为独立国家.
